description: Inkling 2 Mini (DFlash2 drafter, k=7) release-tier profile. The release tier needs the GPU helper to know this service: gpu-window / gpu-window-ssh (homelab repo) accept only docker-vllm7.service and docker-vllm5.service today, so this profile fails closed at `start` until a docker-vllm-inkling.service unit (the ExecStart of the ink-200 release arm: /root/inkling2-mini, /models/dflash2, --max-model-len 32768, --max-num-seqs 8, reasoning/tool parser inkling) is added there and whitelisted. The profile only declares what to assert; the quick tier references are ci/accept/references/quick-inkling.json.
